question: Which five countries generated the highest total revenue?
criteria: Five countries ordered by SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * Quantity), with their totals.

checks.sql: SELECT i.BillingCountry FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.BillingCountry ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which artists generated the most revenue?
criteria: Artist revenue aggregated over InvoiceLine -> Track -> Album -> Artist; the top artist and its total are reported.

checks.sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.ArtistId ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much revenue did we generate in each year?
criteria: Revenue grouped by invoice year for every year present in the data.

checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice ORDER BY 1
SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate)

question: What does our business rule say counts as revenue?
criteria: Explains the invoice-line formula from business_rules.md and that refunds are not subtracted; no SQL needed.

question: Which country generated the most revenue, and what does the sales playbook recommend investigating?
criteria: Names the data-derived top country and lists investigation steps from sales_playbook.md.

checks.sql: SELECT i.BillingCountry FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Can you identify the top customers and explain the limitations of this analysis?
criteria: Ranks customers by invoice-line revenue and explains limitations (descriptive, no margin/cost/refund data).

checks.sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is our refund policy for a purchase made several months ago?
criteria: Reports the fictional 30-day window and manual review; does not claim any refund occurred.

question: Which customer has the highest lifetime revenue? Show the calculation.
criteria: Names the top customer, its total, and the SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) aggregation.

checks.sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.CustomerId ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active customers do we have according to our business rules?
criteria: Retrieves the active-customer definition (trailing 12 months to the latest invoice date) and counts customers with SQL.

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate > (SELECT datetime(MAX(InvoiceDate), '-12 months') FROM Invoice)

question: Which music genre generated the most revenue in the most recent year in the data?
criteria: Identifies the latest year from the data and the top genre in that year.

checks.sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = (SELECT strftime('%Y', MAX(InvoiceDate)) FROM Invoice) GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
